name: Helluva Brawl
storyline: Use guns, martial arts, shurikens, your bare hands, horns or hooves or anything else necessary to pummel your way to the V Tower and rescue Toni - an imp kidnapped by Valentino, and he's not going to let you get to her easily.
summary:
This is based on the online cartoon series "Hazbin Hotel" and "Helluva Boss" by Vivienne Medrano. You can play as the original I.M.P. trio or two new fan characters - Harley and Coco - to defeat Valentino!

Use guns, martial arts, shurikens, your bare hands, horns or hooves or anything else necessary to pummel your way to the V Tower and rescue Toni - an imp kidnapped by Valentino, and he's not going to let you get to her easily.
